semantic_meaning: Shows the mechanism view: the moving parts that actually enforce outcomes.
when_to_use: When a major claim needs a mechanism, not just text
When describing constraints (queues, tooling, capacity, gates)
When transitioning from map to process
when_not_to_use: If you don't have a mechanism to show (avoid empty motion)

animation_behavior.description: Mechanism parts animate in sequence (2–4s beats): gate opens, flow passes, counter updates, lever locks.

input_parameters.name: control_part_id
input_parameters.description: Part that gets amber leverage emphasis.

expected_outputs: Mechanism animation that grounds a claim with structure and control
validation_notes: Avoid UI soup: only show parts that matter to the claim.
Use amber only for the actual lever/control surface.
